changes: Ground-up redesign of Web Player V2 featuring a cinematic dark UI, high-performance Single Page Application (SPA) architecture, HLS.js/VideoJS streaming engine, live EPG, favorites synchronization, and real-time search across Live TV, Movies, Series, and Radio.

Added a dedicated Active Codes REST API with full administrative and reseller actions, including batch generation, status checks, verification, toggling, editing, and deletion with strict permission scoping.
Integrated check_active_code endpoint into both Admin and Reseller API wrappers, enabling external portals and applications to validate voucher codes and subscription statuses programmatically.

Published comprehensive Active Codes API documentation guide (ACTIVE_CODES_API_GUIDE.md) detailing authentication, endpoints, request/response formats, and full multi-language code examples (cURL, PHP, Python, JavaScript).

Overhauled Active Codes management with advanced DataTables, status filters, date range pickers, server-side AJAX pagination, and redesigned batch generator supporting custom prefixes and mass exports.
Decoupled Telegram bot integration completely from XC_VM core into a standalone modular extension (Modules/telegram_3b6df), migrating all notifications to typed PSR-14 MediaAnalyzedEvent listeners.
Expanded Category Templates to Resellers and Sub-Resellers with scoped ownership, shared templates, and added complete support for Radio categories across Admin and Reseller dashboards.
Completely redesigned Category Templates breakdown widget with modern micro-KPI cards (Total, Live, VOD, Series, Radio) and visual proportion distribution bars.

Redesigned Reseller Panel navigation and credit accounting workflows, separating device management into dedicated menus (MAG, Enigma2, m3u/Xtream, Active Codes) with luminous gradient section dividers.
Separated Users from Catalog into standalone sidebar navigation sections in the Admin dashboard for enhanced workflow clarity.
Standardized country selection across Active Code generation and editing forms using normalized GeoReference country dropdowns.
Resolved Web Portal infinite reload loop on missing device info and implemented automatic device credential binding upon login with active code fallback support.
Fixed white screen issues during VOD movie playback by hardening PlayerApiController, get.php media routing, and JSON payload handling.
Standardized AI agent operational guidelines, review personas (backend, db, devops, php, qa, security), and enforced architectural quality gates banning global database access in modules.

Refreshed master installation database (database.sql) to a clean, empty schema containing zero sample/dummy data, synchronized with all database migrations (001-024) and pre-configured for version 2.5.2.
